ValidationRule.description: When the Cross_Sell__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& Cross_Sell__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(Cross_Sell_Comments__c)
|| ISBLANK( Cross_Sell_Annual_Revenue__c )
|| ISBLANK( Cross_Sell_Start_Date__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : Cross-Sell Annual Revenue, Cross-Sell Comments, Cross-Sell Start Date
